project.name: AssetCare
project.summary: A production-deployed Java 25, Spring Boot, Angular and Kubernetes application demonstrating modern full-stack, cloud-native and AI-assisted software engineering.
project.availability: Open source reference application, not for sale.
notes: Runs on one Hetzner CX33 created by Terraform; CI, security and release pipelines on GitHub Actions with signed multi-arch images.
The observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) is an optional profile and is not running in production.
